title: Default branch: the rules and skills say the default branch for daily work, and a release keeps a merge commit
summary: orion's rules and skills now say 'the default branch' for daily work and look it up at run time instead of typing main; a release pull request keeps a merge commit, and orion's own CLAUDE.md names develop as default and main as release (main is both until develop exists).
lessons_learned: A rule that names a branch which does not exist yet needs an 'until it exists' clause, or agents reading CLAUDE.md as overriding the skill's lookup will target the missing branch.
